title: Owens Peak
text: Owens Peak rises to about 8,450 feet in the southern Sierra Nevada, near the center of the Owens Peak Wilderness. It stands about 12 miles west-northwest of Inyokern. It is named for Richard Owens, an Ohio-born explorer who accompanied John C. Frémont on his third expedition to California in 1845 and 1846.
